title: feat(templates): allow Fragment as root
body:
**Summary**

[FX-2735](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-2735)

**Result**

Settled with a `fragment` string after all, allowing a component is trickier to type because of `defaultProps`, and that's technically not what we want.

One problem is that since we still have Hogan templates and Fragment does not allow `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, we need a workaround for still supporting them.
I came up with a component that mounts an empty `div` and immediately sets `outerHTML` with the template's output. Of course this will no longer be necessary once we drop Hogan support.
